reference: Translated distorted Q4 with exactly representable dyadic coordinates. Flux is -K grad(T), the weak conductive nodal load is the sum of the adjacent half-edge contributions, and both assembled matrices are invariant to translation. Errors use the maximum absolute reference entry as the scale.
